verdict.rationale: Docs confirm broad multi-language support (70+ languages, 5k+ voices across 31 languages) and per-language voice settings, plus voice-switching for multi-character/language-tutoring scenarios, suggesting some multilingual flexibility. However, there is no explicit documentation of automatic language detection or seamless mid-call language switching as a distinct feature. missing for 10: explicit language-detection API/setting, documented mid-call auto-switch behavior, hands-on validation of switching accuracy.
